newsitem.title: FRANCE: German Gehe eyes stronger 97 results.
newsitem.headline: German Gehe eyes stronger 97 results.

text.p: German drugs wholesaler Gehe AG, fresh from winning a long-fought battle for UK drugs group Lloyds Chemists, said on Monday the takeover would help lead to clearly improved 1997 results as the year got off to a strong start.
At a news conference, held in Paris, the Stuttgart, Germany based Gehe said it expected sales, including turnover from Lloyds Chemists, to climb by about 10 percent.
The group also said it expected a "clear improvement" in pre-tax operating profit this year.
During the first quarter of this year, Gehe said it had raised its turnover, including Lloyds Chemists, by about 13 percent.
The first quarter pre-tax profit, excluding Lloyds Chemists, showed about a five percent increase.
